verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS productivity suite, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of exporting user data in open formats, such as a takeout or export tool or document format conversion. The admin, directory, reports, SSO and device-management APIs are adjacent administrative features and do not show a user exporting all their data and leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
